notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.26 Released - Save Slots, New Icons & Menu Reworks
notes.content:
[h2]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.26[/h2][p][/p][h2]Save Slots:[/h2][p]You can now have unlimited save slots! Your old save file will automatically migrate to the new system with the name "Demo Game". When starting a new game, you'll be prompted to enter a name for it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/04fa461bc062b96bdbb43834d8464eb790761f60.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Inventory Icons:[/h2][p]The old placeholder icons have been replaced with actual images of the machines/tools
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/bf96e5ba147fdf55851acb25531e6c50ee68aedb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I know lots of people liked the old icons, so I've added an option to re-enable them if you'd prefer :D[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/8a1a9f333c1e2d5d47882a47c2e149cd542140d5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Menu Reworks:[/h2][p]Most of the menus have been updated. The Pause Menu has been redesigned and the Main Menu now shows the latest Steam News post.[/p][p][/p][h3]Old Pause Menu:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/adc8c6d90c96bb79de0792f600864d9ba384bc88.png"][/img][/p][h3]New Pause Menu:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/5d9a5d5dc68495d46434fe210318175dc10e430c.png"][/img]I'm not too happy with how all the extra buttons at the bottom of the new Pause Menu looks currently (Clear physics, turn on/off autominers, etc). I'm glad to hear your suggestions on how to improve them![/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2][list][*][p]Added support for multiple save slots[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Icons for all the items in the game (You can enable the old "programmer icons" in the settings menu if you'd like)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam News feed to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Settings Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the appearance of the "F" Interaction menu[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Diamond & Emerald materials[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Inventory so pressing "ESC" just closes the inventory without opening the Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI Tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where building supports would generate floating sometimes when loading a save file[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory not working properly while the hud is disabled (Now, the hud will be forced on when your inventory is open)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Early Access Release & Closed Beta:[/h2][p]The demo is nearly complete now! We're switching our main focus to the full early access version of the game. The demo will likely receive a few smaller updates, but nothing major.[/p][p][/p][p]First, we need to make a short trailer for the game, then after we development some more content we'll likely have a closed beta test. Join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/QyWQS6ESj5"]Discord[/url] if you're interested in becoming a tester (when available)[/p][p][/p][h2]Preview of what's next:[/h2][p]Here are some WIP screenshots of what we're working on! These won't be coming to the demo, instead to the full Early Access game.[/p][h3]New Machine[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/076e90ddf0d6bcb4414f21643df322a160c6019d.png"][/img][/p][h3]New Machine
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/b0eec09b8f780cc864585d60a563dd17be5eb6e3.png"][/img][/h3][h3]New Tool
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/b1815b8506a5fdb7fac8c45bdcb8aff89cc7e374.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo! We look forward to all your feedback in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3846120/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] and [url="https://discord.gg/QyWQS6ESj5"]Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.25 Released - Shop Rework & New Conveyor Ledge
notes.content: [h2]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.25[/h2][p][/p][h3]Shop Rework:[/h3][p]The Computer Shop has been reworked! It's now organized into categories with a Cart that you can add/remove items from.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/2d1dcaec84ebbc545dd57c2a0440ec702b4e41f1.png"][/img][/p][h3]New Conveyor Ledge:[/h3][p]There's also a new Conveyor Ledge, similar to the Roller Ledge. It's useful for merging conveyor belts![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/7a8756b1e1da09981dd95e477f12603822870a19.png"][/img][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked the Computer Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Added New Conveyor Ledge[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fresnel outline to most grabbable/interactable objects when you look at them[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the colors of the Inventory UI[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the shop & pause menus to blur the background, similar to the inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed computer shop opening when pressing "F" on the table next to it. Now it only opens when you press "F" on the computer itself[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all unlockable shop items always appearing as "NEW!" every time you reload the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some machines using oversized building crates (1x2x2 instead of 1x2x1)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent building crate sizes sometimes when packing buildings with "F" vs Hammer Tool[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the colors on one of the minable gold ore models[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We want to see your factories![/h3][p]We're going to be creating a trailer and updating the Steam Store page soon, and we'd love to feature your amazing creations in it![/p][p]Whether it’s a clever layout, a massive production line, or just something you think looks cool, we want to see it. Share your screenshots (and optionally your save files) in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/QyWQS6ESj5"]Discord[/url], and your factory might make it into the official trailer and Steam page![/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, enjoy these Orenadoes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/0993c9995675d9b1c85a082a19c44383320dd86a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And also..... [b]THE SUN!![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/6ca28f13e801bac8271cf5f1a36929154cd4beb4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo! We look forward to all your feedback in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3846120/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] and [url="https://discord.gg/QyWQS6ESj5"]Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.23 Released - Auto Saving & Chutes
notes.content: [h2]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.23[/h2][p][/p][h3]Auto Saving:[/h3][p]The demo now has autosaving. You can configure it in the settings menu.[/p][p]Also, the amount of resources contributed to active Quests will now save/load properly.[/p][p][/p][h3]Chutes:[/h3][p]There are new buildable Chutes in the demo![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/b6ca9374967ce43ba0a96dd9ebd4c8e8bdb98741.gif"][/img][/p][p]Chutes include 5 main pieces and some alternate models that you can toggle by pressing "Q"[/p][list][*][p]Straight Down Chute[/p][/*][*][p]Top Chute, used for connecting to conveyors or hoppers[/p][/*][*][p]Bottom Chute, used for dropping onto conveyors from above[/p][/*][*][p]Angled Chute[/p][/*][*][p]Splitter Chute[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/cc2032dfd591b91ce1bb062f037196a30853bea1.png"][/img]We're excited to see what you can build with these![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Added Auto Saving (default autosave interval is 5 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Support for Saving/Loading Quest Progress[/p][/*][*][p]Added New Buildable Chutes (Includes 5 main pieces!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added New mirrored version of the Ore Analyzer[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning when pressing "New Game" when you already have an existing save file[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Q button controls hint to be contextual. (It will now specifically say Mirror, Reverse Direction, or nothing at all)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Lamp Pole price (Decreased from 250 to 150)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crushed ore pieces sometimes getting stuck in the Ore Crusher[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating building supports when destroying ore nodes that the supports were connected to[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Resources not being able to be grabbed by the magnet tool with mode "Resources not in Filters" if they were previously inside a filter while the filter was removed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed saying "Polished Ingot Gold" instead of "Polished Gold Ingot"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplication glitch while saving the game in build mode[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo! We look forward to all your feedback in the Steam Discussions and Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.22 Released - Magnet Tool Modes
notes.content: [h2]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.22[/h2][p][/p][h3]Magnet Tool Modes:[/h3][p]You can now press "Q" to switch Magnet Tool modes! Currently, it can switch between grabbing everything, or only Resources (ore, ingots, etc) that are NOT inside any sorter filter baskets.[/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Added ability to change Magnet Tool grab mode! Press "Q" to change the mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added Held Item name to the hud above the controls text[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Autominers to show their Possible Resources when you look at them[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Autominer Possible Resources UI to match the rest of the hud[/p][/*][*][p]Updated loading save files from the pause menu to automatically unpause the game[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Polishing Machine to be slightly faster[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pause menu to use the new logo (however, the menu is still placeholder)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated "Clear all physics objects" button text to specify that it excludes objects in filters[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small objects (crushed ore, diamonds) sometimes falling through the floor when dropped from high up[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you'd like to see a preview of what's next, check out the previous news post! [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3846120/view/506209223025099281"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo! We look forward to all your feedback in the Steam Discussions and Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.21 Released - New Inventory System
notes.content: [h2]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.21[/h2][p][/p][h3]New Inventory:[/h3][p]This version includes a new Inventory system. You can press [b]Tab[/b] to open your inventory.[/p][p](Note that the UI is just a placeholder and will likely be improved in the future)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/26d92aea5d88aebee84327fbe8826af5c119ebf8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Added new Inventory System[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for Super Ultrawide Monitors (Note: Some of the placeholder UI still looks a bit strange)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new "Unstuck" button in the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Crouch" and "Sprint" to the list of controls in the settings menu (not rebindable yet)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where items in your hotbar would get rearranged when loading a save file[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]A preview of what's next:[/h3][p]The demo is getting closer to being finished, so I started prototyping this Grabbing Arm Machine.[/p][p]It's unlikely to come to the demo, instead, it'll likely be included in the Early Access release (or possibly an early playtest)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/131b121847da2a3f04cbc15f2b0c912cdcc84ab5.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700053/27e5718e101299f10e60bbd781d09425db0cd06a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There's still a few things we want to finish for the demo, mainly:[/p][list][*][p]Shop Rework[/p][/*][*][p]Better Menus & UI[/p][/*][*][p]Building System Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]New Sounds & Animations[/p][/*][*][p]Rebindable Controls / Updated Settings Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]After these are complete, we'll likely transition fully to working on the Early Access version![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo! We look forward to all your feedback in the Steam Discussions and Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.20 Released
notes.content: [h3]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.20, which includes some FPS optimizations for super large factories.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Main changes: [/h3][list][*][p]Added "Turn On/Off All Autominers" buttons to the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds & effects to the Rolling Mill[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds to the Sorting Conveyor[/p][/*][*][p]Added Save/Loading support for the Dynamite explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Gold autominers to have a higher chance of getting Diamonds[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum conveyor support length, fixes weird floating supports when building above the ravine area.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased SoundPlayer pool size[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crushed ore sometimes sitting inside the blast furnace, but not getting processed by it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Rolling Mill would stop working if you press "Clear all physics objects" while it's is processing a plate[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3] FPS optimization: [/h3][list][*][p]Added baked occlusion to the cave[/p][/*][*][p]Cached conveyor forward directions[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Quest UI rebuilding[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you have a super large factory, please let me know if your FPS has improved![/p][p]Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo! We look forward to all your feedback in the Steam Discussions and Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.19 Released
notes.content:
[h3]The demo has just been updated to version 0.0.0.19, which contains:[/h3][list][*][p]Added Save/Loading support for physics Ore Pieces[/p][/*][*][p]Updated AutoMiner to remember it's On/Off state when loading save file[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Lamp Pole to be cheaper[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small building crate collisions being slightly smaller than the actual crate[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where your blast furnace could get infinite resources if you pressed "Clear all physics objects" when the furnace was overflowing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crushed Ore sometimes falling through the Ore Crusher, onto the floor below[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ore Analyzer not saying if things are Polished, only if they're Dirt/Unpolished
[/p][/*][/list][p]The highlight is new support for Saving/Loading physics ore pieces. This is a big change, so please let us know if you find any issues with it. We read all your feedback on Discord and the Steam Forums.

Thank you for playing the MineMogul Demo :D[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.0.18 Released
notes.content:
[h3]The demo has been updated to version 0.0.0.18, which contains lots of small quality of life changes, and the ability to load your save file from the main menu:[/h3][list][*][p]Added settings to invert mouse look input[/p][/*][*][p]Added version number to the main hud[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to load save files from the main menu (However, the UI is very placeholder)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Ore Crusher & Rolling Mill to be a little quieter[/p][/*][*][p]Updated blocker conveyor to start in the "Off" position[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Hammer shop description to tell you that you can also press "F" to pickup buildings without needing the hammer.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Ore Analyzer to start locked. It's now unlocked with the Hammer from the Coal quest[/p][/*][*][p]Updated building placement position to be a little lower[/p][/*][*][p]Updated "Clear all physics ore objects" button to NOT clear ore pieces that are inside sorter filter baskets[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Hopper's friction, so things will be less likely to spill[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Note that saving/loading is still work in progress. I plan to continue updating it over the next few days/weeks.

Please share your feedback on Discord or the Steam Forums! We're happy to hear all your thoughts on the game so far :D[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.17 Released
notes.content:
[h3]The demo has been updated to version 0.0.0.17, which contains:[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked the Rolling Conveyors.[/p][list][*][p]They're much faster, slightly more expensive, and now locked by default. They get unlocked with the Rolling Mill.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the first Work in progress version of Saving/Loading[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Saving / Loading:[/h3][p]I just finished the first WIP version of saving/loading. Because this is the first version, I expect there to be some bugs/issues. Note: [/p][list][*][p]The progress on your active quests don't save yet. So, if you had (3/10) diamonds collected, it'll reset to (0/10) when loading the save.[/p][/*][*][p]The physical ore pieces don't get saved yet. This includes ore pieces inside sorting machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Some other things like the minecart and dynamite will get reset when loading a save[/p][/*][*][p]I assume current save files will become incompatible with future game versions. So please don't get to attached to your save :)[/p][/*][/list][p]I plan to continue updating this over the next few days/weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]Saving/Loading is not not integrated into the main menu yet. If you want to load a save file, you need to press "New Game" first, then load it from the pause menu.

Please share your feedback on Discord or the Steam Forums! We're happy to hear all your thoughts on the game so far :)[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.16 Released
notes.content: [h1]Added[/h1][list][*][p]Added a new elevator animation when you first start the game,[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to hold Shift to buy 10 items at a time in the shop (This is just a placeholder until the shop rework happens)[/p][/*][/list][h1]Changed[/h1][list][*][p]Dropped machine crates can have multiple items inside, and pressing G to drop a machine will drop all of them in a single box instead of individual crates[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.15 Released
notes.content: [h1]Added[/h1][list][*][p]Added a new mesa like color shader to the cave walls[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Early Access Demo" popup when you start the game, says things are work in progress,[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixed[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed viewmodel shirt material looking weird[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.0.14 Released
notes.content: [h1]Added[/h1][list][*][p]Added new cave area with foliage and a bridge![/p][/*][*][p]Added new models for dropped building crates[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Wishlist" and "Discord" buttons to the main menu[/p][/*][/list][h1]Changed[/h1][list][*][p]Updated the hotbar to match the rest of the hud[/p][/*][*][p]Any resources that fall out of the world will now get sold[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the Tab inventory screen (will add a working version later)[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixed[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed Rolling Conveyor Ledge not being able to push items over the edge of regular conveyors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ingots getting stuck at the end of the Polishing Machine[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI scaling on the Computer Shop (shop is still wip)[/p][/*][/list]
